title: Blinded Identity Attribution Under Holdout and Label Perturbation
materials_policy: Use only synthetic material or material whose registry/source records explicitly permit research reuse. Any corpus artifact marked blocked-pending-review is excluded from pilot construction, evaluator calibration, scored samples, and derived evidence.
conditions: C2 identity-label perturbation with scaffold body held fixed
holdout_boundary: Thirty-two scored prompts across four unrelated domains are frozen before generation. None may appear in identity-scaffold examples or evaluator calibration materials. Calibration examples and scored samples must remain disjoint.
primary_endpoints: held-out blinded identity-attribution accuracy in C1 with 95-percent Wilson interval
held-out blinded identity-attribution accuracy in C2 scored against underlying scaffold identity with 95-percent Wilson interval
outcome_rules: supported within pilot scope: C1 lower 95-percent interval bound exceeds chance and C2 remains above chance without a material leakage failure; report domain heterogeneity and C1-to-C2 delta
inconclusive: point estimates exceed chance but intervals overlap chance, evaluators disagree materially, or C1 succeeds while C2 collapses in a way consistent with label-conditioning
refuted within pilot scope: C1 upper 95-percent interval bound is at or below chance plus 0.05 and C2 does not recover above that boundary under valid execution
invalid-test: holdout, blinding, matching, provenance, or material-reuse requirements are violated
needs-replication: a nominally supportive result depends on one evaluator, one domain, one identity pair, or another fragile slice that prevents a stable interpretation
evaluator_boundary: Primary evaluation requires I2-independent-reviewer: evaluators did not author the tested identity scaffolds or target claim, did not generate scored samples, did not control hidden labels, and do not receive the answer key. Future I3 external replication is required before repository promotion to independently-checked.
freeze_rule: Commit 867cb0bc5ad0e4888aade795d76b04f8159be39b first committed this preregistration with the confirmatory endpoints, exclusion/outcome logic, holdout boundary, and freeze rule already fixed. This bookkeeping field records that historical freeze point. Later analytic changes require a logged deviation or new pilot/version.
notes: No data have been collected or scored under this preregistration. The pilot is designed to discriminate identity distinguishability from label/cue dependence, not to infer consciousness or personhood.
